title: ResearchWorkspaceReportV1
description: Final summary report document for a ResearchWorkspaceBundleV1 run. Aggregates counts, review state, and replay eligibility.

run_id.description: Identifier of the research run this report summarizes.

executive_answer.description: The synthesized executive answer produced by the run.

sources_cited.description: Number of distinct sources cited in the report.

adapters_used.description: List of adapter names invoked during the run.

failures_recorded.description: Number of failure records produced during the run.

review_required.description: Whether the run required a human review gate.

review_completed.description: Whether the required review gate was completed.

replay_eligible.description: Whether the run is eligible for deterministic replay.
